series.name: Flux STK-PV9000 / STK-PV14000
series.notes: Official Flux manual codes 00-08 mixed warning/fault (separate numbering from SIMREX/SIMRON — do not merge).

meaning.en: Output short circuit; after 3 tries inverter shuts down, restart required.
meaning.ur: output short circuit 3 koshishon ke baad band re-start darkaar

causes.en: Damaged appliance or tool creating the short on the output.
causes.ur: Kharab appliance ya tool output par short bana raha hai.

causes.en: Moisture or a loose joint in the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring mein pani (moisture) ya dheela joint hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC input and PV DC switch at once and unplug the suspected load — never test a short with the unit live.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV DC switch foran band karein aur shak wala load plug se nikaal dein — unit chalte hue short test na karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and each appliance visually and with a meter; repair or remove anything faulty.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output wiring aur har appliance nazar aur meter se check karein; jo kharab ho use theek ya hatayein.

solutions.en: Reconnect a known-good load and restart; if the code returns after three tries, send the unit for repair.
solutions.ur: Koi known-good load laga kar restart karein; teen tries ke baad code wapas aaye to unit repair ke liye bhej dein.

notes.en: Warning table labeled WARNING INDICATOR but short circuit is fault-like.
notes.ur: Warning table mein ise WARNING INDICATOR likha gaya hai, magar short circuit fault jaisa hai.

meaning.en: After 3 tries inverter will shut down, restart is required.
meaning.ur: 3 koshishon ke baad band re-start darkaar

causes.en: Motor or pump start current above the inverter rating.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump ka start current inverter rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many appliances switched on together.
causes.ur: Ek sath bohat sare appliances on ho gaye.

solutions.en: Reduce the load by switching off equipment, then restart the unit so the inverter runs within its rating.
solutions.ur: Equipment band kar ke load kam karein, phir unit restart karein taake inverter apni rating ke andar chale.

solutions.en: Check the total load with a clamp meter if available — motors and pumps draw a high start current.
solutions.ur: Agar clamp meter ho to total load check karein — motors aur pump start par zyada current lete hain.

solutions.en: Restart only after the load is below the rating; if the unit still shuts down, split the load or have it checked.
solutions.ur: Load rating se neeche hone ke baad hi restart karein; phir bhi unit band ho to load baant dein ya check karwayein.

meaning.en: After 3 tries inverter shuts down, restart required.
meaning.ur: 3 koshishon ke baad band re-start darkaar

causes.en: PV1 string oversized or a damaged panel leaking current.
causes.ur: PV1 string zyada bada hai ya kharab panel current leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Water or dust in the PV1 DC connectors.
causes.ur: PV1 DC connectors mein paani ya dhool hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC isolator first, then inspect the PV1 string for damaged panels, water or loose connectors.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV DC isolator band karein, phir PV1 string check karein ke panels kharab, paani ya connectors dheele to nahin.

solutions.en: Measure the PV1 current and voltage with a meter and confirm they are within the unit rating; reduce parallel strings if high.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV1 current aur voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh unit rating ke andar hai; zyada ho to parallel strings kam karein.

solutions.en: Fix or replace the faulty panel or connector, then restart; if the message repeats, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Kharab panel ya connector theek/badal kar restart karein; message dobara aaye to manufacturer se rabta karein.

causes.en: PV2 string oversized or a damaged panel leaking current.
causes.ur: PV2 string zyada bada hai ya kharab panel current leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Water or dust in the PV2 DC connectors.

solutions.ur: Pehle PV DC isolator band karein, phir PV2 string check karein ke panels kharab, paani ya connectors dheele to nahin.

solutions.en: Measure the PV2 current and voltage with a meter and confirm they are within the unit rating; reduce parallel strings if high.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV2 current aur voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh unit rating ke andar hai; zyada ho to parallel strings kam karein.

solutions.en: Fix or replace the faulty panel or connector, then restart; if the message repeats, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Kharab panel ya connector theek/badal kar restart karein; message dobara aaye to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: After 3 tries inverter shuts down, restart required.
meaning.ur: 3 koshishon ke baad band re-start darkaar

causes.en: Grid collapse under load / output sag
causes.ur: Grid load ke darmiyan gir jaye ya output voltage gir jaye.

causes.en: Weak mains supply or voltage drop on a long input cable.
causes.ur: Kamzor mains supply ya lambi input cable par voltage drop.

causes.en: Loose AC input connection or a tripped input breaker.
causes.ur: AC input connection dheela hai ya input breaker trip ho gaya.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and check the mains supply with a meter before restarting.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein aur restart se pehle meter se mains supply check karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC input wiring and breaker for loose terminals or a tripped breaker.
solutions.ur: AC input wiring aur breaker check karein ke terminals dheele ya breaker to nahi trip.

solutions.en: Restart on a lighter load; if the mains keep collapsing under load, have the input circuit checked.
solutions.ur: Halke load par restart karein; load par baar baar mains girein to input circuit check karwayein.

meaning.en: Shift to bypass mode; when temperature normal, inverter restarts automatically.
meaning.ur: Bypass mode: temperature normal par khud ba khud re-start

causes.en: High ambient / heavy load / blocked vents

solutions.ur: Thandak barhayein, khud ba khud re-start
